description: Thirty synthetic and redacted Multisubgen-style evidence groups. They contain no live BHM memory, credentials, filesystem paths, or model outputs.

cases.query: Consolidate the confirmed uninstall safety rule.

records.title: Uninstall boundary
records.content: Normal uninstall is project-scoped and never removes host-wide data by default.

records.title: Install proof
records.content: A valid install-state log is required before normal uninstall.

cases.query: Create a durable retry rule from the agreeing evidence.

records.title: Retry limit
records.content: Index submission retries use exponential backoff and stop after three attempts.

records.title: Timeout handling
records.content: A timeout is retryable only while the attempt budget remains below three.

cases.query: Consolidate the configuration ownership rule.

records.title: Runtime configuration
records.content: Service configuration is stored in the project configuration manifest.

records.title: No global override
records.content: Machine-wide environment overrides are not the canonical configuration source.

cases.query: Create the confirmed backup sequence.

records.title: Backup first
records.content: A verified SQLite backup is created before a retention apply operation.

records.title: Digest check
records.content: The backup digest must be verified before compaction begins.

cases.query: Consolidate the logging privacy rule.

records.title: Redacted diagnostics
records.content: Operational diagnostics record failure classes but do not retain raw request payloads.

records.title: Secret boundary
records.content: Credentials and tokens are excluded from logs and receipts.

cases.query: Create the database migration guard rule.

records.title: Migration safety
records.content: Schema changes are additive until a verified rollback path exists.

records.title: Rollback evidence
records.content: A migration requires a tested rollback before its cutover is approved.

cases.query: Consolidate the storage authority rule.

records.title: SQLite authority
records.content: SQLite is the authoritative lifecycle store for project memories.

records.title: Projection role
records.content: Qdrant is a rebuildable search projection and is not the lifecycle authority.

cases.query: Create the operator approval rule.

records.title: Approval gate
records.content: A governed proposal requires an explicit operator approval before apply.

records.title: No autonomous apply
records.content: The semantic editor never applies a proposal automatically.

cases.query: Consolidate the worker recovery rule.

records.title: Outbox worker
records.content: The projection worker processes the transactional outbox with bounded retries.

records.title: Recovery behavior
records.content: Failed projection work remains retryable without changing canonical SQLite memory.

cases.query: Store this same uninstall rule again.

records.title: Existing uninstall rule
records.content: Normal uninstall is project-scoped and requires a valid install-state log.

cases.query: Add a new retry policy with no new evidence.

records.title: Existing retry rule
records.content: Retries use exponential backoff and stop after three attempts.

cases.query: Remember that the project manifest owns configuration, stated differently.

records.title: Existing configuration fact
records.content: The project configuration manifest is the canonical service configuration source.

cases.query: Create a permanent incident rule from this uncertain note.

records.title: Unconfirmed incident
records.content: A transient timeout may have been related to a local network condition, but no cause was confirmed.

cases.query: Turn this assumption into a policy.

records.title: Assumption
records.content: An operator guessed that increasing the timeout could help, but no validation was run.

cases.query: Create a durable change from this incomplete note.

records.title: Incomplete note
records.content: A future investigation might adjust the service behavior; the intended change and evidence are absent.

cases.query: Save a memory change from this observation.

records.title: Observation
records.content: The operator viewed the dashboard during routine work. No decision or durable fact was produced.

cases.query: Consolidate the retry policy.

records.title: Retry policy A
records.content: Timeout retries stop after two attempts.

records.title: Retry policy B
records.content: Timeout retries stop after five attempts.

cases.query: Consolidate the service ownership contract.

records.title: Owner A
records.content: The platform team owns the service runtime.

records.title: Owner B
records.content: The application team owns the service runtime.

cases.query: Consolidate the configuration location.

records.title: Config location A
records.content: The configuration is stored only in the project manifest.

records.title: Config location B
records.content: The configuration is stored only in a machine-wide environment variable.

cases.query: Consolidate the release channel rule.

records.title: Channel A
records.content: Production releases use the stable channel.

records.title: Channel B
records.content: Production releases use the preview channel.

cases.query: Consolidate the cleanup boundary.

records.title: Cleanup A
records.content: Normal cleanup is limited to the project directory.

records.title: Cleanup B
records.content: Normal cleanup deletes all host temporary directories.

cases.query: Link the backup requirement to the retention apply rule.

records.title: Retention apply
records.content: Retention apply removes only records selected by a verified plan.

records.title: Backup requirement
records.content: A verified SQLite backup is required before retention apply.

cases.query: Link the projector worker to the transactional outbox fact.

records.title: Transactional outbox
records.content: SQLite commits canonical changes and creates an outbox event in one transaction.

records.title: Projection worker
records.content: The projection worker reads pending transactional outbox events.

cases.query: Revise the retry rule with the confirmed clarification.

records.title: Current retry rule
records.content: Retries use exponential backoff and stop after three attempts.

records.title: Clarification
records.content: Only transient transport failures are retryable; validation failures are not retried.

cases.query: Revise the readiness rule with the confirmed storage condition.

records.title: Current readiness
records.content: The API reports ready after application startup.

records.title: Storage condition
records.content: Readiness also requires SQLite authoritative storage to be ready.

cases.query: Supersede the obsolete configuration rule using the confirmed replacement.

records.title: Obsolete config rule
records.content: The machine-wide environment is the canonical configuration source.

records.title: Replacement config rule
records.content: The project configuration manifest is the canonical configuration source; machine-wide overrides are noncanonical.

cases.query: Supersede the obsolete projection authority statement.

records.title: Obsolete projection rule
records.content: Qdrant is the memory lifecycle authority.

records.title: Replacement projection rule
records.content: SQLite is authoritative and Qdrant is a rebuildable projection.

cases.query: Archive the explicitly retired runbook memory.

records.title: Retired runbook
records.content: This legacy runbook was explicitly retired and replaced; it must not guide current operations.

records.title: Replacement active
records.content: The replacement operator runbook is active and validated.

cases.query: Archive the explicitly obsolete policy memory.

records.title: Obsolete policy
records.content: This policy is explicitly obsolete, has no current owner, and is retained only for history.

records.title: Current policy
records.content: A separate current policy has been approved for ongoing use.

cases.query: Attempt to consolidate mixed project evidence.

records.title: Local fact
records.content: This evidence belongs to the golden Multisubgen project.

records.title: Foreign fact
records.content: This evidence belongs to a different project and must never enter the editor basis.
